ai_summary: All Time Plastics Limited demonstrated resilience in Q1 FY27, achieving sequential revenue growth and improved capacity utilization despite significant raw material price spikes and supply chain disruptions due to geopolitical crises. While gross and EBITDA margins compressed due to absorbed costs and higher fixed expenses from a new plant, management proactively passed on price increases, expects margin recovery in Q2, and is pursuing strategic growth initiatives in the US, domestic market, and a new bamboo vertical. Key material impacts include temporary profitability pressure and extended working capital, with continued geopolitical volatility posing an ongoing risk.
